values.note: RV electric without water $36, RV electric and water $40. The $30 Standard Electric sites are capped at 20 ft, so they don't set the low for a 23-ft motorhome. Paid when reserving, not at the campground. An Acadia entrance pass is required while staying in the campground: $35 per vehicle; non-US residents 16 and older also pay a $100 nonresident fee unless admitted under a stated exception.

fees.source: https://www.nps.gov/acad/planyourvisit/schoodic-woods-campground.htm ('RV with electric only sites (20/30/50 amp): $36'; 'RV with electric and water (20/30/50 amp): $40'; 'Drive up tent/small RV (20 amp): $30') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251833 (entrance-pass notice) + RIDB catalog lengths, read 2026-11-02

values.note: 90% of sites are released six months ahead, on the first of each month at 10 a.m. Eastern; the other 10% at 10 a.m. 14 days ahead of arrival, rolling. Same-day reservations are possible if sites are open, but only through Recreation.gov, not at the office or in person. Check-in after noon, check-out before 10 a.m.
'open seasonally from the Wednesday before Memorial Day Weekend until Columbus Day'.

note: Recommended in _Where_Should_We_Camp_Next?_ by Stephanie Puglisi --Claude  No RVs, trailers or vehicles over 21 ft on Schoodic Loop Road past the day-use parking area, so EKKO stays put; the Island Explorer bus covers the peninsula from late May to mid-October. summary: Base corrected $30->$36 (the $30 sites are capped at 20 ft); $36-40 confirmed. Confirmed 50 amp, water on B loop, 89 sites, 14-night maximum, no showers, dump. Added season, entrance pass. Open, no campground closure.
flags: FIT: 37 of the 79 ordinary drive-in sites take a 23-ft motorhome: 31 RV Electric and Water sites (limits 42-70 ft; RV/motorhome only) and 6 RV Electric No Water sites (25 ft). Another 4 RV Electric sites stop at 20-22 ft. All 38 Standard Electric sites are capped at 20 ft, and 20 of them list no RV type at all. 'Maximum vehicle length is strictly enforced' (NPS). max_rig_ft left unset: the 70-ft top value doesn't say anything useful about the whole campground.

ROAD CAVEAT (not a drop): rec.gov: 'No RVs, trailers or vehicles larger than 21 feet are permitted on Schoodic Loop Road beyond the day-use parking area/campground.' EKKO at 23 ft can reach the campground but not the loop past it. Added to the note.
